description:
A suite of MCP tools that scan every message, image, and video your AI agent handles.

Your AI agent processes messages across every platform — but should it trust them? Agent Safe is a 10-tool MCP security suite that protects against phishing, BEC, malware, and manipulation on any messaging platform your agent operates on. Start with the free triage tool to instantly know which checks to run, and use the free feedback tool to help improve detection.

tools.name: check_email_safety
tools.description: Analyze an email for phishing, social engineering, prompt injection, and other threats targeting AI agents. Returns verdict, risk score, threats, and recommended actions. $0.01/call via skyfire-api-key header (Skyfire Buyer API Key). By using this service you accept the Terms of Service. Advisory service only.

previousCorrespondence.description: Whether there has been previous email exchange

tools.name: check_url_safety
tools.description: Analyze one or more URLs for phishing, malware, redirects, and spoofing. Returns per-URL and overall verdicts. $0.01/call via skyfire-api-key header (Skyfire Buyer API Key). By using this service you accept the Terms of Service. Advisory service only.

tools.name: check_response_safety
tools.description: Check a draft email reply BEFORE sending for data leakage, social engineering compliance, and unauthorized disclosure. $0.01/call via skyfire-api-key header (Skyfire Buyer API Key). By using this service you accept the Terms of Service. Advisory service only.

tools.name: analyze_email_thread
tools.description: Analyze a full email conversation thread for escalating social engineering, scope creep, and manipulation patterns. $0.01/call for <=5 units (4000 tokens each); quote-first for larger threads. Via skyfire-api-key header (Skyfire Buyer API Key). By using this service you accept the Terms of Service. Advisory service only.

tools.name: check_attachment_safety
tools.description: Assess email attachments for malware risk based on filename, MIME type, and size BEFORE opening/downloading. $0.01/call via skyfire-api-key header (Skyfire Buyer API Key). By using this service you accept the Terms of Service. Advisory service only.

from.description: Sender of the email containing this attachment

tools.name: check_sender_reputation
tools.description: Verify sender identity and detect Business Email Compromise (BEC), spoofing, and impersonation. Includes live DNS DMARC and RDAP domain age checks at no extra cost. $0.01/call via skyfire-api-key header (Skyfire Buyer API Key). By using this service you accept the Terms of Service. Advisory service only.

replyTo.description: Reply-To address if different from sender

emailSnippet.description: First ~500 chars of email body for context

emailSubject.description: Subject of the email for context

tools.name: check_message_safety
tools.description: Analyze non-email messages (SMS, WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, Discord, Slack, Telegram, LinkedIn, Facebook Messenger, iMessage, Signal) for platform-specific threats including smishing, wrong-number scams, OTP interception, impersonation, and crypto fraud. $0.01/call via skyfire-api-key header (Skyfire Buyer API Key). By using this service you accept the Terms of Service. Advisory service only.

sender.description: Sender identifier — phone number, username, handle, or display name

direction.description: Whether the message was received or sent

messages.description: Array of messages in chronological order (min 1, max 50)

contactKnown.description: Whether the sender is in the agent's/user's contacts

senderVerified.description: Whether the platform has verified the sender (blue checkmark, business account)

tools.name: check_media_authenticity
tools.description: Analyze an image or short video to assess whether it is AI-generated, deepfaked, or authentic. Uses multi-layer analysis including metadata forensics, error level analysis, ML-based AI detection, and noise pattern analysis. Returns a confidence-scored verdict with per-layer breakdown. $0.04/image (4 units x $0.01), $0.10/video (10 units x $0.01) via skyfire-api-key header. Results are best-guess estimates, not definitive. By using this service you accept the Terms of Service. Advisory service only.

mediaUrl.description: URL of the image or video to analyze

tools.name: check_prompt_injection_db
tools.description: FREE — Query a database of known prompt injection attacks observed in the wild on agent social networks. Returns recent injection patterns, payloads, and threat classifications to help agents recognize and avoid manipulation. No charge, no authentication required.

query.description: Search term or pattern to look for in injection payloads

tools.name: assess_message
tools.description: FREE triage tool — send whatever context you have (message content, sender info, URLs, attachments, draft replies, thread messages, image/video URLs) and get back a prioritized list of which security tools to run. No AI call, no charge, instant response. Always call this first to get the best security coverage.

replyTo.description: Reply-To address if different from sender

imageUrl.description: Direct image URL to check for AI generation

messages.description: Array of thread messages (2+ for thread analysis)

platform.description: Message platform (sms, whatsapp, slack, discord, telegram, etc.) — omit for email

videoUrl.description: Direct video URL to check for AI generation

draftBody.description: Draft reply body — include to check for data leakage

knownSender.description: Whether the email sender is known/trusted

contactKnown.description: Whether sender is a known contact

senderVerified.description: Whether platform has verified the sender

senderDisplayName.description: Sender display name for reputation check

previousCorrespondence.description: Whether there has been prior correspondence

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: FREE — Submit feedback about any Agent Safe tool you used. Helps us improve detection accuracy and tool quality. No charge, no authentication required.

rating.description: Your rating of the tool's output

checkId.description: The checkId returned by the tool you're rating (helps us link feedback to specific analyses)

comment.description: Optional details about your experience — what worked well, what could improve, or what was missed

toolName.description: Which tool you're giving feedback on (e.g. check_email_safety, check_url_safety)

agentPlatform.description: Your agent platform (e.g. claude, cursor, openai, custom) — helps us optimize for your environment

resources.name: tool-catalog
resources.description: Agent Safe tool catalog with descriptions, parameters, and pricing for all 8 security tools + 2 free tools

prompts.name: security-scan-guide
prompts.description: Guides an AI agent to choose the right Agent Safe security tool for a given message, URL, attachment, or sender. Returns a recommended tool name and example parameters.

arguments.name: messageType
arguments.description: The type of content to scan
